reference.scope: Keyboard-only commands: mouse, joystick, external driver, chat, demo, network, pause and save inputs are inactive.

scope: Every combination of ten movement/button/modifier bits at eight turn-ramp positions, including the five/six-tic boundary and long holds.
All 256 simultaneous weapon masks with four modifier/button masks; the first pressed numeric key wins as in the original routine.
Original G_BuildTiccmd is compiled unchanged with keyboard inputs and inactive mouse/joystick/network/chat/demo/pause/save boundaries.
Every native merged scan-code binding individually.
All 256 arrow/strafe and WASD alias combinations, every bit held, then complete release.
Controls initialization and command sampling allocate no memory.

limitations: This supplies native held-key commands; the application host must sample once per tic and control focus, pause, lifetime and rendering.
Mouse/joystick, demo/network commands, save requests and pause toggling are outside this keyboard-command contract.
This does not qualify the unfinished game for the catalog.
